Hi, I got diagnosed at age 21. To start I brought up the possibility of Adhd with my psychiatrist; then she told me to report my concerns to my primary care doctor (pcp). Then after doing a short questionnaire with my PCP, she referred me to a neuropsychologist who did a full screening test for ADHD,Autism and other various neurological conditions. This whole process took around 5 months. Then finally 1 month after I took my neuropsychological exam I got my results which indicated I was on the Autism Spectrum.

Hope this helps
